messages:
oncall-bot: Incident opened — billing-alerts detected unusual overage_flags spike for metering. Severity: P2. Runbook: https://redwood.inc/runbooks/metering-drift

maria.k: Observed token-count drift in EU region starting ~2024-07-12 03:12 UTC. Quick numbers: expected tokens=1.25M, emitted seen=1.8M on shard-7.

ajay: Any customer-facing impact yet? Are customers receiving overage emails?

billing-ops: Some EU customers got auto-overage emails between 03:20-03:40 UTC. Also seeing delayed usage reports for a subset of accounts. Pausing auto-notifications now.

sre-rotations: Commands to check: `kubectl logs deploy/emitter-7 --since=20m | grep heartbeat` and `kafka-consumer-lag --group metering-ingest --topic metering.events`

maria.k: emitter-7 heartbeats show intermittent ~30s gaps. Kafka lag ~45k on partition p7. Error sample: ```ERROR commit failed: timeout``` — looks like retries happening.

ops_bot: Note created: INC-2024-487 (metering emitter retries / inflated counts)

ajay: Is this duplicate emission (double-emit) or an ingest ack miss that triggers replays?

maria.k: Initial triage: emitter retried on commit timeout; some clients are sending null req_id so dedupe key `(client_id, req_id)` degenerates. Retries + null req_id => dedupe bypass, inflated counts.

billing-ops: Hypothesis aligns with customer reports. Plan: 1) pause replayers, 2) enable dedupe-by-hash fallback, 3) pause auto-overage emails.

sre-rotations: Actioning now. maria.k — can you pause replayer for shard-7? ajay — prepare dedupe fallback deploy. billing-ops — confirm email pause.

maria.k: Pausing replayer: `./scripts/replayer control pause --shard 7` — done :white_check_mark: (03:33 UTC)

ajay: Deploying dedupe-hash fallback (hotfix): `deploy metering/dedupe:hotfix-2024-07-12` — canary started (03:36 UTC).

billing-ops: Auto-emailing paused globally at 03:38 UTC — confirmed :no_entry_sign:

ops_bot: Pager update: INC-2024-487 status -> mitigation_in_progress

liz: Looping in SE/customer outreach. ETA for normalization?

maria.k: If hotfix passes canary, backlog should drain and counts normalize in ~20-30m. Scaled ingestion workers x2 already.

ajay: Canary passed at 03:45 UTC, rolling hotfix across remaining shards. Watch metric `metering.duplicates_rate`.

sre-rotations: Observed duplicates_rate dropping from 0.002 -> 0.0004 over 10m, kafka lag decreasing. Nice. :thumbsup:

billing-ops: Preparing manual customer notes and reconciliation steps. Draft template posted to #templates for review.

liz: Good. Post-incident items: RCA for null req_id client behavior, tighten SDK validation, add emitter-retry-rate alert. Assigning to maria.k and ajay.

oncall-bot: Incident resolved at 03:58 UTC. Summary: temporary inflated token counts due to emitter retries combined with null req_id dedupe bypass. Mitigations: paused replayers, deployed dedupe-hash fallback, scaled consumers. No persistent data loss. Billing team to run reconciliation and suppress false overage charges.

maria.k: Opening follow-up ticket for billing reconciliation: BILL-2024-88 — will include timeline and affected accounts.

ajay: Postmortem draft created: https://redwood.inc/pm/metering-dedup-pm -- adding timeline and metrics.

liz: Thanks everyone. Please add timeline entries, alert thresholds changed, and client SDK validation checklist to the postmortem.
